subject: MATHEMATICS
applicability_conditions: a candidate answer can be checked against original equations, conditions, units, or geometry
use when verification is not self-initiated even though prompted checking may be possible
anchor: A mathematical answer is not finished when a value is obtained; it is finished when the value is checked against the original conditions.
ordinary_language_bridge: Return to the question's original conditions, not merely the last transformed line.
reconstruction_route: choose a check method appropriate to the object
replay the candidate through every independent condition
interpret any mismatch as evidence to revisit the reasoning

minimal_contrast.focal_distinction: checking only the last derived equation versus checking the original problem conditions
minimal_contrast.prediction_prompt: Which check can detect an earlier illegal transformation?
minimal_contrast.decisive_feature: verification must be independent enough to test the original obligation

misconception_discriminator.candidate_wrong_model: reaching a plausible value or re-reading the derivation counts as verification
misconception_discriminator.probe: offer a candidate produced by an invalid step that still satisfies the last line but not the original
misconception_discriminator.decisive_response: learner checks the original and rejects the candidate

known_limitations: some proofs require structural justification rather than numerical substitution
